description: This bar chart illustrates the Module Giga FLOPs consumed by four different types of attention mechanisms—labeled in the legend as blue for “attention,” red for “grouped attention (g=3),” yellow for “patch attention (k=3),” and green for “feed-forward”—across three stages of an audio back-end Conformer model. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by “Audio back-end Conformer Stage,” with three distinct groups labeled “Stage 1 (d=180, n=500),” “Stage 2 (d=256, n=250),” and “Stage 3 (d=360, n=125).” The vertical axis, labeled “Module Giga FLOPs,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Within each stage, four bars are grouped side-by-side, each representing one of the attention types and their respective computational cost. In Stage 1, the blue “attention” bar is the tallest at approximately 0.28 Giga FLOPs, followed by the red “grouped attention (g=3)” bar at about 0.15 Giga FLOPs, the yellow “patch attention (k=3)” bar at approximately 0.11 Giga FLOPs, and the green “feed-forward” bar at around 0.13 Giga FLOPs. In Stage 2, the blue “attention” bar is approximately 0.16 Giga FLOPs, the red “grouped attention (g=3)” bar is around 0.13 Giga FLOPs, the yellow “patch attention (k=3)” bar is approximately 0.12 Giga FLOPs, and the green “feed-forward” bar is about 0.14 Giga FLOPs. In Stage 3, the blue “attention” bar is approximately 0.12 Giga FLOPs, the red “grouped attention (g=3)” bar is about 0.11 Giga FLOPs, the yellow “patch attention (k=3)” bar is approximately 0.11 Giga FLOPs, and the green “feed-forward” bar is around 0.14 Giga FLOPs. The bars are not sorted but are presented in the order of the legend. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or outlines.
